name: main
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.PrNumber) AS prs, sum(s.CostUsd) / nullif(count(DISTINCT p.PrNumber), 0) AS avg_cost, sum(s.InputTokens + s.OutputTokens) / nullif(count(DISTINCT p.PrNumber), 0) AS avg_tokens, count(DISTINCT s.SessionId) / nullif(count(DISTINCT p.PrNumber), 0) AS sessions_per_pr FROM agent_sessions AS s INNER JOIN pull_requests AS p ON concat(s.RepositoryOwner, '/', s.RepositoryName) = p.RepositoryFullName AND s.GitBranch = p.HeadBranch WHERE p.PrMergedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND p.PrMergedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
